aggregateMethod: aggregateOverallScore = mean of per-response overallScore across all successfully-evaluated emails accumulated so far (failures and not-yet-attempted items excluded, never counted as 0). aggregateDimensionScores = the same mean applied per dimension. overallScore itself is computed by lib/ai/evaluate.ts as the lowest of: a weighted average of the six dimensions (relevance 25%, groundedness 25%, completeness 20%, toneEmpathy/clarity/professionalism 10% each); the weakest dimension + 1.5; and a risk-flag cap of 4.9 for a critical flag (unsupported refund promise, unverified fix claim, invented policy/fact) or 6.9 for a major flag (ignored customer's question, inappropriate tone).
